market_story: STORAGE: ERCOT batteries clear most of their value as ancillary services - the measured 60-Day awards run 1.25 GW (2023) to 2.8 GW (2025) of RegUp/RRS/ECRS/NonSpin - and ERCOT Nodal Protocols 3.17.3 obliges an ESR to HOLD STATE OF CHARGE backing every award for the product's duration. The real fleet therefore walks into the scarcity evening with most of its tank pledged: at the 61 actual >$1000 hours of 2023 it held 2,125 MW of awards = 2,705 MWh frozen of its ~4.1 GWh and discharged only 423 MW (delivery-2023 SCED telemetry). The energy-only LP saw the power dock but not the energy pledge, so it drained the whole tank into the peak (666 MW there; 2025 evening +462 to +1,268 MW over the 930-BAT actual). With the SOC backing floored at award x published duration, model discharge at 2023 scarcity falls to 520 MW and the 2025 evening net-discharge lands on the measured shape (18h 3,033 vs actual 2,995). GAS: the withheld battery energy is replaced at the margin by CC/CT dispatch in the same evenings - the direction ERCOT's own scarcity-hour composition shows (the model ran -1.9 GW of gas vs actual in those hours). AS deployment: the measured award DRAW-DOWN at the net-load ramp (the armed deployment floor) still releases both the power and - now - the energy behind it, so ramp co-participation is preserved, not stacked (rule 19).
